paite: Huan Elim a pan azin zom zel ua, Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan apawtkhiak nung uh akha nihna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in Israel suante Sin gamdai atung ua, huai Elim leh Sinai kikal a om ahi.
heading: Manna Leh Vengkeng

paite: Gamdai ah Israel suan omkhawmte Mosi leh Aaron dem in aphun uhi.

Israel suante'n akiang uah, "Sa bel bulte a i tut lai un, khamtak a tanghou i nek lai un, Aigupta gam ah TOUPA khut in na si zaw mai lehang. Hiai a omkhawm tengteng kial a hon that dia, hiai gamdai a na hon pikhiak tak ziak un," achi uhi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, nou a ding in van a pan tanghou ka hon zusak ding. Huchi in mite apaikhe ding ua, niteng daih ding bangzah zah hiam alakhawm ding ua, ka dan ah a-om uhiam om lou, amau ka etchet theihna ding in.
Ani guk ni in, hichi ahi ding a, ahon lakte uh abawl ding ua; niteng a alakkhawm uh mun nih a tam ahi ding,” achi hi.
Mosi leh Aaron in Israel suan tengteng kiang ah, "Nitaklam in huai hun in TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan ahon pikhia chih na thei ding uhi.
Zingsang huai hun in TOUPA thupina na mu ding ua; TOUPA kalh a na phunnate uh lah azata ngal a. Kou bang ka hi ua, ka tung ua na phun uh?"

Mosi in, "Nitaklam a nek ding sa, zingsang a kham ding tanghou TOUPA'N ahon piak chiang in hiai na mu ding uhi. Amah tung a na phunnate uh TOUPA'N azata ngal a. Kou bang ka hi ua? Kou kalh a phun na hi kei ua, TOUPA kalh a phun na hi zaw uhi," achi hi.
Mosi in Aaron kiang ah thu agen a, "Israel suan omkhawm tengteng kiang ah TOUPA ma ah hong pai nai un. Na phunnate uh lah azata ngal a, chi in,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aaron in Israel suan omkhawmte tengteng kiang a thu agen lai in, gamdai lam a-et uleh, ngai in, meipi ah TOUPA thupina ahong dawk hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
"Israel suante phunna ka za; akiang uah thu gen in. Nitaklam in sa na ne ding ua, zingsang lam in tanghou na kham ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, nitaklam in vengkeng ahong tungtou ua, giahphual ahong tuamdim ua; zingsang in giahphual kimvel ah daitui akia hi.
Daitui kia a-om nawn louhtak in, ngai in, gamdai pumpi ah thil bem neu, lei lak ah zing daitui khal ngou chia a neu a-om hi.
Israel suante'n amuh un, “Hiai bang ahia?" akichituah ua, bang ahia chih lah athei ngal kei ua. Mosi in akiang uah, "Hiai TOUPA'N ahon piak na nek ding uh tanghou ahi.
Michih in ama khamkhop ding zah la hen. Na mite uh zah dungzui in, michih a ding in omer khat la uhen chi a, TOUPA'N thu apiak hiai ahi. Michih in apuanin a om ding zah la un," achi hi.
Israel suante'n huchibang in ahih ua, akhen in tam deuh, akhen in tawm deuh ala uhi.
Omer a ateh uleh atam la in bangmah anei val kei a, atawm la in bangmah atasam tuan kei hi. Michih in akham ding bang zel in ala uhi.
Mosi in, "Kuamah in zingsang tan nutsiat nei kei hen," achi hi.
Hinapi in Mosi angaikhe kei ua; alak ua khenkhatte'n zingchiang tan in akoihkhol ua, athan a, a-uih hi. Huchi in atung uah Mosi ahehta hi.
Zingsang teng in, michih in akham ding bang zel in ala ua; ni ahong sat chiang in azul hi.
Ani guk ni in hichi ahong hi a, tanghou amun nih a tam mi khat a ding in omer nih zel ala uhi. Khawmpite heutu tengteng ahong ua Mosi ahilh uhi.

Ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai TOUPA chihsa ahi, zingchiang TOUPA a dia Sabbath siangthou khawlna ahi. Na kan nop uleh tuni in kang unla; na huan ding uleh huan un. Avalte zingchiang tan a ding in kikoih un," achi hi.
Mosi thupiak bang in azingchiang tan akoih ua, a-uih kei a, athan leng a-om kei hi.
Mosi in, "Tuni in huai ne un; tuni lah TOUPA a dia Sabbath ni ahi ngal a. Tuni in gamlak ah tanghou na mu kei ding uh.
Ni guk na lakhawm ding ua; himahleh ani sagih ni Sabbath ni ahi, huai ni in bangmah a-om kei ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in lakhawm ding in mi khenkhat apaikhia ua, himahleh bangmah amu kei uh.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Bang tan ka thupiakte leh ka dante zui lou ding na hi ua?
En in, TOUPA'N Sabbath ni ahon piak ngalleh, huaiziak a, ani guk ni a ni nih a ding tanghou hon pia ahi. Michih amun ah om henla, ani sagih ni in amun a pan kuamah paikhe kei hen,” achi hi.
Huchi in mite ani sagih ni in akhawlta uhi.
Israel inkote'n amin Manna asa ua; koriandar tang bang ahi a, angou a; chep in tanghou pei khuaizu soh abang hi.
Mosi in, "Hiai thil TOUPA thupiak ahi. Na khang na khang ua ding in omer khat thundim un. Aigupta gam a pan ka hon pikhiak lai a, gamdai a ka hon vakna tanghou amuhtheihna ding un," achi hi.
Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Bel la inla, huai ah omer khat manna dim koih in, TOUPA ma ah luikhia in, na khang na khang ua zuih ding in," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in, Aaron in Theihpihna ma ah, koih ding in aluitouta hi.
Gam kiluah ahong tun masiah uh, Israel suante'n kum sawmli sung manna ane uhi. Kanaan gamgi ahong tun masiah uh, manna ane uhi.
Omer khat, ephah khat mun sawm ahi.
